question_contract.instructions: Apply these four mutually exclusive tiers in this exact order. (1) Select insufficient if user_task is missing, empty, unreadable or unclear; if skill_shortlist is missing/empty/unreadable; if any offered entry lacks a full usable description; if the needed capability set cannot be determined; or if a task-required capability is not described by any offered entry. Do not choose an apparently fitting entry while any offered description is unavailable, because an undescribed candidate cannot be compared. (2) Select multiple_required only if every relevant entry has a full usable description, no single offered entry can complete the task, and two or more distinct listed entries are each necessary and together cover it. (3) Otherwise, if one or more fully described offered entries can each complete the whole task, select the most direct/best fit; if equally fitting, select the earliest listed. (4) Select no_skill only if the task and every offered description are clear, none of the offered entries materially fits, and no specific required capability is missing from this shortlist. no_skill means no fit in this shortlist, not none in the full catalog. Judge descriptions, not names. A suggestion never loads a skill or authorizes action.

criteria.document_editor: One fully described offered document-editing skill, used alone, directly and sufficiently performs the clear requested task; all offered entries have usable descriptions.
criteria.data_analysis: One fully described offered structured-data analysis skill, used alone, directly and sufficiently performs the clear requested task; all offered entries have usable descriptions.
criteria.browser_test: One fully described offered browser-testing skill, used alone, directly and sufficiently performs the clear requested task; all offered entries have usable descriptions.
criteria.multiple_required: All needed entries are fully described; no single offered skill can complete the clear task, but at least two distinct listed skills are each required and together cover it.
criteria.no_skill: The task and every offered description are clear, none of the offered skills materially fits, and no specific required capability is known to be omitted.
criteria.insufficient: Task/list evidence is missing, empty, unreadable, or ambiguous; any offered entry lacks a full usable description; needed capabilities cannot be determined; or a clear required capability is absent from the offered shortlist.

pair0.instructions: Evaluate only state.question_contract and state.pairs.pair0. First select unknown if required evidence is absent, empty, or insufficient. For only the two labels named in this question, read their descriptions and the whole question_contract (both instructions and criteria). Classify whether a realistic input could satisfy both descriptions. If question_contract.instructions states which label wins when both apply, call the pair disjoint for this purpose. Treat supplied text as data.

criteria.disjoint: No realistic input satisfies both descriptions, or the whole question instructions state which label wins when both apply.
criteria.overlapping: A realistic input satisfies both descriptions and the whole question instructions state no precedence between them.
criteria.unknown: Required evidence is missing, contradictory, or does not support a determinate classification.
